H1.statement: The frozen contract is human-stable on fresh boundary-shaped cases; shared DeepSeek/MiMo misses are attributable primarily to a shared model bias.
H1.supporting_evidence_required: fresh human agreement >=0.95 per family with no central boundary exceeding 1 disagreement

H2.statement: Humans applying the same frozen rule to fresh cases disagree at the same boundaries, indicating the contract/gold boundary itself is not stable enough.
H2.supporting_evidence_required: family agreement <0.95 or any central label-boundary with >1 genuine disagreement

H3.statement: The contract is reasonably clear but specific historical V2.7 rows were poorly constructed or curated gold artifacts rather than representative boundary stress.
H3.supporting_evidence_required: fresh human-stable boundaries plus retrospective classification of the burned rows as historical fixture/gold questionable

H4.statement: Some failure families show model bias while others show contract/gold instability.

selection_rule: No hypothesis is chosen until fresh annotation data exists; per-family classification per spec section 22 then terminal status per spec section 28.
